films.title: MADE Chapter Two
films.description: Emerica's 2016 full-length concludes the MADE series with parts from Jon Dickson, Bryan Herman, Andrew Reynolds, Eniz Fazliov, Rob Maatman, Jeremy Leabres, Leo Romero, Brandon Westgate, Collin Provost, Kevin "Spanky" Long, Jerry Hsu and Justin "Figgy" Figueroa. Filmed by Jon Miner and Bucky Gonzalez and edited by Miner, the 41-minute film was reissued in full on Emerica's official channel.
